description: Creates an Lambda layer from a ZIP archive. Each time you call PublishLayerVersion with the same layer name, a new version is created.

researchLinks.description: "But without PassRole it should be fine", Lambda edition
We Found Eight Attack Vectors Inside AWS Bedrock. Here's What Attackers Can Do with Them

securityImplications: Attackers might use PublishLayerVersion to publish a malicious Lambda layer in an account they control, which is then attached to a victim function so their code runs under the function's execution role without needing iam:PassRole.

simulation.value: aws lambda publish-layer-version --layer-name TrailDiscover --zip-file fileb://layer.zip --compatible-runtimes python3.12
